chapter_title_en: The War Council and the Xingtian Formation
chapter_seo_title: Desolate Era Ch. 518: War Council – The Xingtian Formation Deployed
chapter_meta_description: The Xia Emperor reveals the war plan against the Seamless Gate: 11,000 Celestial Immortals and a million Loose Immortals will train in the legendary Xingtian Formation, turning armies into an invincible divine spirit.
og_title: The War Council – Desolate Era Ch. 518
og_description: Nine armies, each with 100,000 immortals, will unite under the headless war god Xingtian. Who will command them?
twitter_title: Desolate Era Ch. 518 – The Xingtian Formation
twitter_description: The Xia Emperor unveils a battle formation so powerful it turns 100,000 Loose Immortals into the body of an invincible Fiendgod.

lore_anchors.definition: In Chinese mythology, Xingtian is a severed giant who never stopped fighting—using his nipples as eyes and navel as a mouth. In Desolate Era, he is a legendary True God of the ancient human imperial clan.
A massive war formation requiring 100,000 Loose Immortals as a foundation and 1,000 Celestial Immortals as a framework, manifesting a temporary Xingtian divine spirit of god-tier durability.

A Ki Refiner who failed their Heavenly Tribulation and became an immortal with a limited lifespan, subject to periodic tribulations. In war, they are prized for their raw ability to draw vast amounts of ambient energy.
A Celestial Immortal who has achieved Pure Yang status through mastery of a Grand Dao, representing a qualitative leap in power and status.
The pillar of the Dongyan clan, now revealed to have advanced from Celestial Immortal to Pure Yang True Immortal since the last Immortal Fortunes Assembly.
The founding royal clan of the primordial Pangu world, including legendary figures like Suirenshi and Shennongshi. They are among the most powerful factions in the Three Realms.
A supreme Daofather under Mother Nuwa's command, whose realmverses include the Grand Xia world. The Celestial Immortals present are under his authority.
A Xianxia concept representing a realm's accumulated destiny or luck; losing it makes a world vulnerable to conquest, and protecting it is a strategic priority.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why is this chapter mainly a war meeting?
cultural_notes_faq.a: The novel is transitioning from individual progression to large-scale war; this council establishes the strategic stakes and introduces the formation mechanics that will define the coming battles.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why are Loose Immortals treated as 'cannon fodder' if they are so powerful?
cultural_notes_faq.a: Individually powerful, they are undisciplined and vulnerable to concentrated attacks. Formations turn their raw energy draw into an asset, while Celestial Immortals provide the control they lack.

cultural_notes_faq.q: What is the significance of Xingtian's backstory?
cultural_notes_faq.a: It establishes the ancient human imperial clan's immense power and the Xia Emperor's political backing, showing that the Grand Xia's defense is connected to the oldest, most terrifying forces in the Three Realms.
